home_intro: Create short lists, share them with the people you live or work with, and add items with your voice. Changes show up for everyone in real time.
not_found_text: This page doesn't exist or has moved.
sign_in_intro: Enter your email: we'll send you a link to sign in, no password needed. New here? Your account is created on the way.
check_email_text: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
welcome_intro: What's your name? It's shown to the people you share lists with.
error_invalid_otp: This code is wrong. Check the latest email we sent.
error_otp_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
error_name_too_long: Your name is too long (60 characters at most).
error_network: Checkit can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
lists_empty: You don't have any lists yet. Create your first one.
items_empty_editor: This list is empty. Add your first item.
all_items_empty_all: Your lists have no items yet.
delete_item_text: It will be deleted for every member of the list. This can't be undone.
dnd_instructions: To move an item, press Space, use the arrow keys, then press Space again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
dnd_cancelled: Move cancelled: “{label}” is back at position {position}.
delete_list_text: The list and all its items will be deleted for every member. This can't be undone.
list_not_found_text: This list doesn't exist, was deleted, or isn't shared with you.
error_save_failed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
error_list_name_required: Enter a name for the list.
error_list_name_too_long: The name is too long (100 characters at most).
error_item_label_too_long: The item is too long (200 characters at most).
error_item_label_taken_any: This item is already in the list.
toast_item_restored: “{label}” was checked: it's back on the list.
toast_access_lost: You no longer have access to “{name}”.
connection_closed: Live updates are off. Reload the page to see the latest changes.
remove_member_text: They will no longer see the list. You can share it with them again later.
leave_list_text: You will no longer see this list. Someone will have to share it with you again.
share_links_intro: Anyone with a link can join the list after signing in. Revoke a link to stop it from working.
revoke_link_text: Nobody will be able to join with it anymore. People who already joined stay members.
error_already_member: This person is already a member of the list.
error_too_many_invitations: This list has too many pending invitations. Cancel some first.
join_role_editor: You'll be able to see the list and change its items.
join_role_viewer: You'll be able to see the list.
invitation_wrong_account: This invitation was sent to {email}, but you're signed in as {me}.
sign_out_to_switch: Sign out to use that address
invitation_expired_title: This invitation is no longer valid
invitation_expired_text: It has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
share_link_revoked_text: The list's owner revoked it. Ask them for a new one.
profile_intro: Your name is shown to the people you share lists with.
pwa_description: Short to-do lists, shared in real time.
offline_text: Checkit needs a connection to show your lists. The page will reload by itself once you're back online.
install_text: Open your lists in one tap from your home screen, like an app.
install_ios_title: Add Checkit to your home screen
install_ios_step_share: Tap the Share button, in the browser's toolbar.
install_ios_step_add: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. Don't see it? Scroll down the list.
install_ios_sign_in: Then open Checkit from your home screen: you'll sign in once more there, with a code we email you.
sign_in_intro_code: Enter your email: we'll send you a code to sign in, no password needed. New here? Your account is created on the way.
